cohort: The study included healthy term infants divided into three feeding groups: high sn-2 palmitate formula (n=30), regular vegetable oil formula (n=32), and breast milk (n=30).
finding: Formula milk enriched with sn-2 palmitate resulted in a gut microbiome functional profile that more closely resembled that of breastfed infants, promoting Bifidobacterium breve proliferation and enhancing microbial ecology robustness compared to regular formula.
